mentions.name: Online cycling calculator (tire power/speed comparison)
mentions.description: An online cycling calculator that emphasizes the power and speed differences between different tires. It lets users play with various settings to see what actually impacts their cycling speed, cutting through forum misinformation. A free weekend project with no monetization plans; the author is seeking help with graphic design and HTML.
mentions.problem: Cycling forums are full of audiophile-style pseudo-scientific claims about equipment; the tool exists to show what really impacts speed.
mentions.audience: Cyclists who want to fiddle with different settings and see what really impacts their speed while cycling.
mentions.source_excerpt: Yet another online cycling calculator, this time with an emphasis on power/speed difference between different tires.
